title: Allows readers to manually play the prompt sound
goal: provides native playback controls and text descriptions for audio.
summary: There is an offline audio section on the registration introduction page. Allow visitors to decide when to play and read what the beep means.
tasks: Add controls to #arrival and keep the ready-made source.
Add aria-describedby association #transcript, wait for readers to play when the page is opened.

example.code: Sound description: Two bells represent the end of the break.
example.note: controls provide play and pause. Text descriptions help readers who cannot hear the audio access the same information.

hint: controls is a Boolean attribute. Keep the sound file address and use aria-describedby to write the ID of the description paragraph.
